result.title: Go Far, Look Less: Active Multi-Room Reconstruction with Persistent Goals and Selective Views
result.summary: Active 3D reconstruction aims to allocate a sparse view budget to recover complete geometry and high-fidelity renderings. However, existing methods degrade sharply in multi-room homes: myopic next-best-view scoring gives transit no credit for distant rooms and over-polishes irreducible nearby residuals, whereas dense mappers reach far rooms only by streaming thousands of frames. We propose ROAM-GS, a training-free active multi-room reconstruction framework that couples persistent goals with selective views: each decision selects a goal and a variable-horizon prefix toward it, capturing only at its endpoint. A Surface Reconstruction Memory scores poses by projecting post-update defects and viewing directions. Persistent goals credit transit with their remaining value and are released once arrivals stop measurably improving them. Without per-scene tuning, ROAM-GS achieves state-of-the-art multi-room reconstruction while preserving single-room Replica fidelity, raising mean coverage from 74% to 93% on HSSD and from 47% to 96% (+11.7 dB PSNR) on HM3D, and matching 90-minute dense mapping using $173\times$ fewer views.

AI.brief_summary: 提出无需训练的主动多房间3D重建框架 ROAM-GS：每步选择一个持久目标及通向它的可变长度视角前缀，仅在端点采集；用表面重建记忆按更新后缺陷与视线方向评分位姿，并在到达不再带来可测增益时释放该目标，从而以稀疏视角预算获得高覆盖重建。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「目标剩余价值记账＋可测增益触发的释放/停止＋端点才采证」的决策结构，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 的预算分配、中间步骤贡献分配与证据筛选提供概念线索，可供核查是否能迁移到多模态推理。
